t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Orange, Green, Red, Blue Gnomes lead to bright forest with a red basket. Blue, Pink, Yellow & Purple Gnomes lead to dark forest with yellow basket. Other attributes not relevant. Player needs to identify which forest has the most mushrooms in order to maximize bonus.

vb_textbox.text: Advice for the game. Two sets of gnomes. They look different but basically only the colour of their hat is important.Orange, Green, Red and Blue gnomes lead you to the bright forest with a RED basket. Brown, Yellow, Purple and Pink lead you to the dark forest with a YELLOW basket. Pick the colours that take you to the forest with the most mushrooms. The game switches up which forest has the best mushroom crop. You will notice that the amount of mushrooms to collect begins to drop - at this point you will need to switch between forests to improve the amount of mushrooms collected. The stocks seem to replenish somewhat if you focus on one forest for a while. Do not worry if you choose the 'wrong' gnome every so often because you need to check the position in the other forest anyway to recognize when a switch is taking place. Occasionally the numbers being collected are fairly equal between the forests.
